integrity_note: The general theorem is proved by CRT, cyclic gap compositions and binomial inversion. Exact finite enumeration independently corroborates the formulas; it is not presented as a proof for unbounded parameters.
scientific_limitations: Assumes a common pairwise gcd and intervals of length at most this gcd. Does not cover general gcd patterns, long intervals, or an arbitrary lonely-runner instance. Historical-priority uncertainty remains for an equivalent cyclic-arc distribution theorem. Older continuous random-arc coverage papers were compared at abstract level only; full texts may contain related formulas.
title: Exact solution-count laws for short intervals in multiway Chinese remaindering
